svg.title: The inbox handler, step by step
svg.desc: The HandleInbox use case acknowledges, reads, parses, authorizes, and stores the attachments of one email; each step can fail with a typed error, which either rejects the email or fails the handler, and a processed or rejected email is deleted.
svg.text: withHandlerOutcome: the file has no more use
3 retries with backoff, then the error
a defect also fails the handler
